name: follow-before
what: The Friday before, Mar 15: the band isn't in force yet, the card says what the flow gives, and the sheet says the change comes later

name: follow-card
what: Larkspur's month, Mon Mar 18, the day the WAF's band takes effect (ADR 0026 §7): the change is Evidence feeds', whose file it is about, and its card says CHANGED; Applications, which only follows it, says what it gives

name: follow-sheet
what: Its sheet says what changed: each change with the day it takes effect from, what it did, who recorded it and why, and where it stands for the day on screen; then the flows that read it and follow

#sheet .fl-changed: After Tuesday's monitor mode, the security lead wants a WAF failing more than a tenth of its applications held, from Monday
in force on the day on screen
Applications and Larkspur estate read it, and follow: nothing is copied.

name: follow-follows
what: A flow that reads it: Applications' sheet says what it follows, and whose each change is

#sheet .fl-changed: A flow reads the flows it lists as they are: nothing is copied.

name: follow-dark
what: What changed, in the dark scheme

name: follow-test
what: The change tested on the days recorded: each of the last 14 days before it takes effect run again under it as a what-if, nothing published and nothing recorded; the sheet and the status line then say what it found, and the day that was on screen is on screen again

expect.status: ^Under the changed Evidence feeds, all of the last 14 days come out the same\.$

#sheet .fl-change[data-change=\"waf-band: Under the changed Evidence feeds, all of the last 14 days come out the same.
